allow: PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\nodejs\\node.exe", "${env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)}\\nodejs\\node.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\nodejs\\node.exe", "$env:APPDATA\\npm\\node.exe"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { Write-Output "FOUND: $p" } }; Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Source)

PowerShell($tools = @\('python','python3','magick','convert','inkscape','node'\); foreach \($t in $tools\) { $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { Write-Output "$t -> $\($c.Source\)" } else { Write-Output "$t -> NOT FOUND" } })
